messages:
dylan: Heads up, eu cache invalidation task failed after last deploy, users seeing intermittent 504s. Want to push a hotfix and short canary. @neha can you triage?
neha: looking. Saw logs showing nil pointer in cache loader for empty shard list. I have a minimal patch branch hotfix/cache-null-check that adds guard + retries. Staged smoke passed.
zara: oncall ok to expedite if we keep canary small. Rollback if 504 > 0.8% sustained over any 7m window or if error spike > 2x baseline.
dylan: request expedited approval to bypass 30m window; product hits customers. Approve?
zara: approve, add temp route pin to eu-edge until confirmed.
neha: plan: `/deploy hotfix hotfix/cache-null-check --env=eu-west1 --canary=4% --monitor=7m --pin-route=eu-edge=temp-hotfix` I'll run and post notes.
deploy-bot: command received: `/deploy hotfix hotfix/cache-null-check --env=eu-west1 --canary=4% --monitor=7m --pin-route=eu-edge=temp-hotfix`
deploy-bot: starting 4% canary in eu-west1, monitor window 7m. Notifying ops and release.
ops-bot: sampling traces and error rates. will report every 2m.
(3m in)
ops-bot: canary update: 504 on canary hosts 0.18% (baseline 0.2%). CPU/memory stable. Trace shows guard hitting as expected.
dylan: expand to 30% then monitor 7m. If still good flip pin.
neha: scaling: `/deploy scale hotfix hotfix/cache-null-check --to=30% --monitor=7m`
deploy-bot: scaling canary to 30% in eu-west1.
ops-bot: 4m into 30% window: 504 0.22%, p95 latency improved by ~20ms. No downstream errors.
zara: proceed to 100% after window. Keep support on standby for customer comms.
support: drafting short message: "We rolled a fix for intermittent embeddings cache errors in EU; monitoring continues."
(8m later)
deploy-bot: canary passed. promoting to 100% in eu-west1. route pin applied: eu-edge=temp-hotfix -> hotfix/cache-null-check (temporary)
ops-bot: post-promote checks: 504 down to 0.04%, p95 back to baseline. No regression alerts.
dylan: closing expedited approval. Neha, please post release note with commit hash and revert steps. Also add the rollback command to the runbook.
neha: release note: "hotfix/cache-null-check (commit ef12b9c) 8; guard for empty shard list + retry logic. Rollforward OK. Revert: `/deploy rollback ef12b9c --env=eu-west1`"
